intake.title: Tell us what happened
intake.hint: Write it in your own words. Include a flight number if you have one.
intake.placeholder: Our flight DXB-402 just landed, our gate changed to B14 and my grandmother needs a wheelchair
intake.example.wheelchair.label: Wheelchair at the door
intake.example.wheelchair.text: My grandmother needs a wheelchair at the aircraft door.
intake.example.gate.label: Gate changed
intake.example.gate.text: My connecting gate changed and I need to know where to go.
intake.example.tight.label: Tight connection
intake.example.tight.text: We landed late and have a tight connection.
intake.error.unreachable: We could not reach SkyAssist. What you wrote is still here. Check the connection and try again, or ask staff.
intake.error.rejected: That did not go through. Check what you wrote and try again.
flightq.title: Which flight are you connecting to?
flightq.hint: It is on your boarding pass, for example ZX 515.
flightq.label: Connecting flight number
flightq.unknown: We could not find {flight}. Check the number, or pick it from the board.
primary.lost.title: We lost the live connection
primary.lost.body: Last checked {time}. The gate and route below are from then and may have changed. Check a flight board or ask staff before you move.
primary.wait.pending: Stay at {place}. We have asked staff for help.
primary.wait.dispatched: Help is on the way. Stay at {place}.
primary.declined: Staff could not send help. Go to the nearest staffed help point.
primary.verify: Check your gate before you move
primary.answer_above: Answer the question above and this fills in.
primary.stay: Stay here. This screen updates by itself.
journey.route_locked: Directions start once staff have reached you.
system.offline_note: Gates, routes, timing and staff requests run on this kiosk. Voice, hosted language models and live aircraft need the internet.
system.simulated_note: Flights, gates and the terminal plan are synthetic in this demo.
system.setup_hint: Add {name} to the .env file and save it. No restart needed.
ledger.gate.stale: The gate was last seen a while ago and may have changed
ledger.transfer.unknown: Walking time not worked out yet
ledger.margin.verified: {margin} min to spare in the worst case
ledger.margin.conditional: {margin} min to spare, if the assistance request is approved
ledger.margin.negative: {margin} min short in the worst case
ledger.assistance.pending: Assistance requested. A coordinator has not approved it yet
ledger.assistance.approved: Approved. Waiting for confirmation that a staff member is on the way
ledger.assistance.dispatched: A staff member is on the way
ledger.assistance.declined: Request not approved. Please go to the nearest help point
ledger.assistance.expired: Request timed out. Please go to the nearest help point
answer.verdict.tight: It is tight, so start moving now.
answer.verdict.at_risk: You may miss boarding. Please ask staff for help now.
answer.verdict.impossible: Boarding has closed for this flight. Please go to the nearest help point.
answer.verdict.unverified: I cannot confirm your timing yet.
answer.urgent: If this is an emergency, go to the nearest staffed help point now. Staff there can call for help.
answer.scope: I can help with your gate, boarding time, route and assistance.
answer.nothing_yet: I do not have your flight yet. Tell me your flight numbers.
answer.help_offer: I can request staff help for you. I will ask you to confirm where to meet first.
answer.no_promise: I cannot promise an outcome. Here is what is confirmed.
